mentions.name: fittingme.ai
mentions.description: A product-page widget set for fashion e-commerce that answers how a garment might look on a shopper and which size to order. The virtual try-on renders the garment using a shopper's photograph, while the size recommendation component estimates the user's measurements, uses the brand's size chart's estimated measurements, and suggests a size plus a fallback. Merchants integrate both through two widgets.
mentions.problem: Online fashion shoppers can't easily tell how a garment will look on them or which size to order.
mentions.audience: Fashion e-commerce merchants who integrate the widgets, and their shoppers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on https://fittingme.ai, a product-page widget for fashion e-commerce.

It answers two questions that are usually handled together inside the fitting room: “How might this look on me?” and “Which size should I order?”

The virtual try-on renders the garment using a shopper’s photograph. 
The size recommendation component estimates the users measures, use the brand’s size chart estimated measurements and suggests a size plus a fallback.

The merchant integrates both through two widgets.
